name: Best of AI

sources.title: Submit page — free hand-reviewed listing; approved tools propagate to category/profession/alternatives pages, newsletter, and GitHub awesome list
Submit portal — 'pick a plan including a free one', paid plans via PayPal, account required to track status

requirements: AI tool that actually works: 'the site has to load, the AI feature has to be real, and it has to do roughly what the landing page claims'
Wrapper apps are acceptable if they add value; a pure reskin is rejected
Closed-beta/waitlist tools may be submitted but are only listed once publicly open
Pick a plan at submission — a free plan exists; paid plans via PayPal
preparation: Category pick from 143 categories (closest match; they fix mis-categorization)
A free account on submit.bestofai.io to track submission status
Site URL that loads reliably for review
workflow: Drop in the site URL — details are pulled automatically once signed in
Fill name, tagline, description, logo, screenshots (~5 minutes claimed)
Choose the free plan (paid plans pay via PayPal)
Team reviews by hand; once approved the listing deploys to category, profession, and alternatives pages plus the newsletter and GitHub awesome list (best-of-ai/best-of-ai)
Track status on the My Submissions page
watchFor: Two different surfaces: bestofai.io/submit (info page) vs submit.bestofai.io (the actual portal)
Paid plans and an 'Advertise' upsell exist — free plan is sufficient for a permanent listing
Rejection is usually for a dead site, fake AI feature, or no category fit; resubmission is unlimited after fixing
Listing goes live 'with the next site deploy' — approval does not mean instant publication
Optional GitHub star on best-of-ai/best-of-ai is solicited during review but not stated as required
countsAsLive: The tool appears on its bestofai.io category page / Recently Added, with a direct-follow link to the product site
unknowns: What the paid plan tiers cost (prices not shown on fetched pages)
Exact review turnaround — 'a few days' is the only claim
Whether the free plan limits placement vs paid plans
